s3.p: Four simple steps from meeting a cat to bringing them home.

list.p: Browse our cats and kittens and find someone who catches your eye.
Use the Apply button on the cat's page to fill in our application form, with a little about yourself and the home you could offer.
All adoptions are subject to a home check. [Add a line on what to expect.]
Pay the adoption donation ([£ amount]) and take your new family member home.

s4.p2: Monthly gifts come in set amounts. For any other amount, choose One-off.
s4.p3: You'll complete your gift on a secure payment page.
s4.p4: **£200** is what it costs, on average, to rehome one cat. Cats who need medical attention can cost considerably more. Prefer another way to give? Try a [bank transfer or standing order](/ways-to-help/), our [Amazon wish list](/ways-to-help/) or [fundraising](/ways-to-help/).
s4.alt: A black-and-white tuxedo cat sitting on a wooden floor, looking up

s4.text: [What £5 a month covers: add a real cost from Happy Paws]
s4.p: Every donation brings us one step closer to rescuing and rehabilitating cats in need. Your support helps provide food, shelter and medical care to the most vulnerable.

s5.p2: Fostering is the vital stepping stone in our work. It gives cats a safe place to settle while they wait for their forever home.
s5.p3: A cake sale, car boot, quiz night or coffee morning. We'd be overjoyed to hear your idea.
s5.p4: We're always in need of supplies. Our Amazon wish list makes it easy to donate exactly what we need.
s5.p5: Join our team and make a difference in the lives of cats in need.
s5.p: Adoption isn't the only way to support our rescue. If you can't adopt, there are plenty of other ways to make a difference.

s6.alt: A woman sitting on a rug holding a dark cat, with a second cat walking along the sofa behind her
s6.h2: Happy Paws Cat Rescue began with a simple mission: to give every cat a second chance at life.
s6.p: It was founded by Katrina, who has wanted to help cats in need ever since she was a little girl, and it has grown from a small effort in Stockton into a team of dedicated volunteers. Whether it's a kitten in need of a warm place or an older cat looking for a forever home, we're here to help.

s7.quote: Being with the this rescue and adopting our new family member was amazing. They were able to help us find an amazing addition to the family and we couldn't be any more grateful. Thank you!
